prompt_en: Photograph an adult fashion model in her late twenties, using the supplied portrait as the visual reference for her face and long dark wavy hair. Create a garment-aware fashion lookbook photograph in a quiet coastal ferry terminal. She wears a burgundy wool cape with clearly shaped shoulder seams and a curved lower hem over charcoal tapered trousers and polished black ankle boots. She stands upright with both boot soles planted on the dry concrete floor, feet comfortably apart, and her torso facing the camera. Her right hand emerges through the cape arm opening and gently pinches a small section of the right outer hem between thumb and index finger, holding it a few inches outward; the lifted cloth hangs in a shallow curved fold back toward her right thigh. Her left arm hangs naturally through the left arm opening with the hand visible beside her hip. The cape front, shoulder construction, wool texture, lifted hem edge and complete trouser silhouette remain readable. A single chrome folding chair stands beside her with a clear gap between its frame and her boots. Tall ferry-terminal windows show a subdued sea horizon. Cool skylight defines the burgundy wool, while a small warm side reflection touches one garment edge. Frame her full length with floor beneath both boots, balanced architecture, lifelike skin texture and a calm direct gaze. The photograph presents the actual drape and construction of the garment as its visual center. Use a vertical portrait frame with a narrow band of floor beneath the boots and open breathing room above the hair. Position the distant window mullions so their receding rhythm converges behind the chrome chair, leaving the cape outline against a broad quiet window pane. A normal focal length and level camera preserve the garment proportions.
